items.html:
(to the question) Ehyeh with a filling of Yudin, of Alfin, and of Hehin
The level of upper Ima is divided into three phases: HBD, HGT, NHY. And Ehyeh with a filling of Yudin is in the YH of her, that is, in HBD, when she receives from the corresponding phase in SAG of AK from the Tabur upward, where the second restriction, which is the phase of Alfin, had not yet taken root. And Ehyeh with a filling of Alfin is in her HGT, which receives from the corresponding phase below the Tabur of AK, where the second restriction had already taken root, and hence the fillings are with Alfin, as above, page 563, answer 1. And Ehyeh with a filling of Hehin is in her NHY, which are the phase of Achoraim, whose filling is with Hehin. (Part 1, Page 160, Item 105; Part 1, Page 162, Item 111).
